verdict.rationale: Loops is an email SaaS that holds customer contact and email data, so a policy or control against using that data for AI training is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions AI training, data-use policies, or any opt-out control. The cited material covers only APIs, MCP, CLI, pricing and migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
